thread:
mina: FYI - found tenants reporting unexpected v2 tokens in billing while they're pinned to v1. Looks like dashboard aggregation is double-counting probe tags + final serve.

evan: Ugh. Is this the same OR-aggregation bug we discussed last quarter?

kai: Possibly. Quick repro: missing client header causes router to emit a probe tag (v2_probe) then pinned v1 serves. Console sums by any tag in window so counts go to both.

sam: For billing we need a single canonical attribution. I'm in favor of adding billed_variant + billed_tokens at ingest. Console can default to that.

mina: Agree. Keep raw.tags for debugging but don't use them for billing.

evan: Rollout plan idea: shadow write billed_* metric to a separate namespace for 14 days, run compare job, then flip billing consumer to prefer billed_tokens.

kai: telemetry schema change should include reason enum: pin_precedence, fallback, cache_warmup, probe. That helps UI explain surprises.

sam: Also add schema_version so backfills are safe. If billed_tokens missing, billing falls back to raw.tokens_sum.

mina: Console UX: default 'Attributed' view (uses billed_tokens) and 'Raw' toggle. Hover text explains difference.

evan: Ops note: block the deprecation banner from triggering SDK header rewrites. If SDKs need probes they must set probe_intent=true so telemetry can mark it.

ingest-bot: ingest-check: schema change detected. Recommend two-phase deploy: staging ingestion + shadow, then console/ billing flip.

sam: I'll open RFC & PR for pipeline transform. Kai can add the schema and shadow namespace.

kai: Will do. I'll also add an automated compare script and sample report.

mina: Action items assigned. Finance needs a heads-up before flip if any tenant >2% delta. Evan, can you handle that notification?

evan: Yep, will monitor compare job and notify #finance if needed.

mina: Good. Let's keep raw signals for a month in longer retention for audits.

sam: Agreed. Filing RFC now. Thanks all.
